newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt lower.
Confirmed - 56,500 Last week - None Year Ago - None
WK to date - 82,100 Last week - 30,200 Year Ago - 1,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs
61.50 to mostly 62.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 61.50 to mostly 62.00, few North Plains 62.50-63.00.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 33,900 slaughter steers and 22,600 heifers; 82,100 head confirmed for week to date which includes 25,600 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
